title: Chernobyl Disaster Tracker Update — May 16, 2026
summary: The 40th anniversary of the Chernobyl disaster on April 26, 2026 was marked by ceremonies at the plant site and in Kyiv, with surviving liquidators returning to the exclusion zone and Ukrainian President Zelenskyy accusing Russia of nuclear terrorism through repeated drone attacks. IAEA Director General Grossi signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Ukraine for emergency repairs to the New Safe Confinement arch, damaged in a February 2025 drone strike — with €500M needed and full restoration targeted for 2030. On May 7–8, Russian Shahed drones crashed in the exclusion zone, igniting a 1,100-hectare wildfire; radiation levels remained within normal limits but firefighting was hampered by landmines. Zelenskyy also signed a decree honoring liquidators with a new state medal ahead of the anniversary.
